description: Single storey front extension incorporating front porch; conversion of garage to habitable room; single storey side to rear extension; external alterations
decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height: normal;">The proposed single storey rear extension by reason of its depth and height on the boundary with No.8 Home Mead would result in an overbearing structure leading to loss of light,&nbsp; overshadowing and a detrimental sense of enclosure on neighbouring occupiers.&nbsp; As such, the development is contrary Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and guidance in the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm">The proposed front extension by
reason of its two front doors and porch roof in combination with the front
extension's roof would result in incongruous and awkward&nbsp;addition to the
dwellinghouse and street scene contrary to the high quality design aspirations
of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), D3 D(7) and D(11) of
The&nbsp; London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy
(2012), Policy DM1(c) of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan
(2013) and guidance in the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential
Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>
